Cursor pagination (nextCursor) is only on /jobs/api, the browse feed. 13/03/2026: The API has been updated to include the companySlug field in the response.","updatedAt":1795711902,"offset":0,"limit":20,"totalCount":845,"jobs":[{"title":"Graphic Designer","excerpt":"We are hiring a Graphic Designer for our client, one of the most trusted entrepreneurship media brands in the world.","companyName":"Agencyhires","companySlug":"agencyhires","companyLogo":"https://cdn-images.himalayas.app/eujljhpkylnona25u6ern2g92acx","employmentType":"Full Time","minSalary":null,"maxSalary":null,"salaryPeriod":"annual","seniority":["Mid-level"],"currency":"USD","locationRestrictions":[],"timezoneRestrictions":[8],"categories":["Graphic-Designer","Graphic-Artist","Graphic-Design","Graphic-Designer-Illustrator","Graphic-Web-Designer","Creative-Graphic-Designer","Print-Graphic-Designer","Freelance-Graphic-Designer","Graphic-Illustrator","Graphic-Design-Specialist"],"parentCategories":["Design"],"description":"

We are hiring a Graphic Designer for our client, one of the most trusted entrepreneurship media brands in the world.

Our client started as a small digital magazine in Australia and grew into a global education and media company for founders. Today, their content reaches over 1M entrepreneurs each month through podcasts, courses, newsletters, events, social media, and their membership platform.

Their podcast has featured some of the biggest names in business, including Mark Cuban, Tim Ferriss, Tony Robbins, Richard Branson, Arianna Huffington, Seth Godin, Barbara Corcoran, Daymond John, Reid Hoffman, Simon Sinek, Alex Hormozi, Emma Grede, Neil Patel, Gary Vaynerchuk, and many more.

Now they need a talented Graphic Designer who can turn ideas, stories, and business insights into compelling visual content that stands out across digital platforms.

A Day in This Role

You start the day with a new batch of content from Foundr's podcast, social media, or upcoming campaigns.

There are ideas to communicate, stories to tell, and an audience of entrepreneurs to capture.

Your job is to bring those ideas to life visually.

You design scroll-stopping social media graphics, create polished promotional assets, develop campaign visuals, and turn complex ideas into clear, engaging designs that feel unmistakably on-brand.

You might be creating Instagram carousels, podcast promotional graphics, YouTube thumbnails, email banners, or landing page visuals. Each design has a purpose: capture attention, communicate a message, and strengthen the brand.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the content and marketing teams, take creative direction, explore new visual approaches, and refine your work based on feedback and performance.

You end the day knowing your designs helped one of the world's leading entrepreneurship media brands connect with millions of founders.

What You'll Do

You will create high-quality visual assets that support our client's content, marketing, and brand initiatives.

You will:

  • Design engaging social media graphics, carousels, and promotional creatives

  • Create compelling visuals for podcasts, interviews, campaigns, and digital content

  • Design YouTube thumbnails, email graphics, banners, and other marketing assets

  • Maintain visual consistency across different platforms and content formats

  • Translate creative briefs and marketing concepts into effective visual designs

  • Develop layouts, typography, color combinations, and visual compositions that capture attention

  • Adapt designs for different platforms, audiences, and campaign requirements

  • Work with brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas to the table

  • Collaborate with content and marketing teams to bring campaigns and ideas to life

  • Incorporate feedback quickly and continuously improve the quality of your work

  • Keep up with emerging design trends, creative formats, and visual styles

You're Right for This If

  • You have strong graphic design experience and a portfolio that demonstrates your creative ability

  • You have an excellent eye for typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy

  • You know how to create designs that are both visually appealing and effective at communicating a message

  • You understand what makes social media graphics stand out and capture attention

  • You can translate ideas and creative briefs into polished visual assets

  • You have a strong understanding of branding and visual consistency

  • You are comfortable working across multiple design formats and platforms

  • You can balance creativity with speed and attention to detail

  • You are proficient in professional design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma

  • You are organized, reliable, and comfortable working remotely

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You rely heavily on templates and struggle to create original designs

  • You focus on making things look attractive without considering the message or purpose

  • You have difficulty following brand guidelines or maintaining visual consistency

  • You struggle with typography, spacing, alignment, and visual hierarchy

  • You need someone else to provide direction for every creative decision

  • You are unwilling to experiment with new ideas or take creative feedback

  • You consistently miss deadlines or struggle to manage multiple design requests

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience designing for business, entrepreneurship, or personal brands

  • Experience working with established media brands or digital publications

  • Experience creating high-performing social media graphics and carousel content

  • Experience designing landing pages, email campaigns, and digital marketing assets

  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills

  • Experience using AI-powered design tools in your creative workflow

  • An understanding of conversion-focused design and marketing principles

Why This Role Is Exciting

  • You will create visual content for one of the most respected entrepreneurship media brands in the world

  • Your designs will reach millions of entrepreneurs across different platforms

  • You will work with content featuring some of the biggest names in business

  • You will help shape the visual identity of established shows, campaigns, and new content launches

  • You will work with a media brand that has been building for over a decade

  • You will have creative room to experiment, develop new ideas, and elevate the brand's visual presence

Compensation

Competitive pay based on your region, tool subscription reimbursements, fully remote, ongoing training, and more!

Ready to Create Visuals That Inspire Entrepreneurs?

If you have a strong eye for design, love turning ideas into compelling visuals, and want your work to reach a global audience of founders, this is a rare opportunity to sharpen your craft at a leading entrepreneurship media brand.

Apply now!

NeoWork is hiring Graphic Designers to create on-brand visual content for U.S. companies. You will design social posts, ads, marketing materials, and brand assets that look great and perform.

NeoWork is a global staffing and operations partner that builds dedicated remote teams for fast-growing U.S. companies. Our teammates work directly inside our clients' teams and tools, while NeoWork takes care of recruiting, HR, benefits, and ongoing support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design social media graphics, paid ads, email assets, and marketing materials
    • Create presentations, one-pagers, and brand collateral
    • Follow brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas
    • Adapt designs for multiple formats and platforms
    • Collaborate with marketers, copywriters, and video editors on campaigns
    • Manage design files and deliver on tight, recurring deadlines

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional graphic design experience
    • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and/or Figma
    • A strong portfolio showcasing recent work
    • Solid understanding of typography, layout, and color
    • Good written and spoken English for working with U.S. teams
    • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
    • Based in Argentina, with a reliable home office setup and stable internet connection

Nice to Have

  • Experience with motion graphics or video
    • Experience designing for e-commerce or performance marketing

Benefits

  • We offer health insurance for contractors

• Holiday Extra Pay

  • The work hours generally align with standard business hours in the US, with some potential flexibility depending on the client's needs.
    • This is a 100% home-based position
    • We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
    • In addition to the base salary, performance-based incentives are provided.
    • There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.
    • There are ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.

RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

About Evo

For over 20 years, The Evolution Championship Series (Evo), has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are rallying points where fans, publishers, developers, and brands celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them. Beyond our established live events, Evo’s mission continues to evolve to create, celebrate, and renew fighting game fandom.

Role Overview

Evo is looking for a talented, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our creative team. This is a mid-level role for a designer who can translate creative direction into polished, effective visual assets across event collateral, social media assets, broadcast graphics, and marketing collateral.

The ideal candidate has a clean, modern design aesthetic, solid fundamentals in typography and visual communication, and the ability to move confidently between fast-turnaround digital work and print production. You should be comfortable working within established brand systems while also bringing thoughtful creative ideas to the table.

Reporting Structure

You will report to Evo’s Creative Director.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support Evo's creative output by designing assets for a variety of Evo events, initiatives, and projects.
  • Create social media graphics and other digital marketing assets.
  • Design digital maps, schedules, wayfinding materials, and event information graphics.
  • Create web assets across Evo's digital platforms.
  • Develop broadcast graphics for Evo tournaments and events.
  • Design event signage, environmental graphics, and other on-site materials for Evo events.
  • Create YouTube thumbnails for both the Evo FGC and Evo Events channels.
  • Design presentations and decks for internal use, client presentations, and partner-facing materials.
  • Prepare, package, and distribute production-ready files for print vendors and other external partners.
  • Collaborate with creative, sales, comms and marketing teams to execute projects from concept through final delivery.
  • Maintain consistency with Evo's brand standards as well as the visual guidelines of relevant partners and clients.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in graphic design or other relevant fields.
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • Adobe Photoshop
    • Adobe Illustrator
    • Figma
    • Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Slides
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, and fundamental graphic design principles.
  • Competency in print production, including preparing files for professional printing and understanding production requirements.
  • Strong design portfolio demonstrating a clean, modern, and thoughtful design aesthetic.
  • Proven ability to package, organize, and distribute files accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow, apply, and maintain brand standards and guidelines across Evo, partner, and client work.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard for craft and execution.
  • Ability to receive creative direction, incorporate feedback, and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, event-driven environment.
Bonus Points
  • Passion for fighting games, esports, gaming and gaming communities.
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation.
  • Experience with 3D design, rendering, or visualization.
  • Experience with web design and digital product design.
  • Experience with photo editing, compositing, and retouching.
  • Previous experience designing for live events, entertainment, sports, or other high-energy audience-driven environments.
Compensation

The salary for this role is $55,000.00 to $80,000.00 depending on experience.

Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  • 401k plan available for employee contributions
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
  • Remote-first culture

We’re looking for a freelance, multi-disciplinary Creative Designer to join our team and support us with a variety of creative projects across graphic design, landing pages, Figma, video editing, and animation.

We need someone who can work across different types of content rather than specializing in just one area.

What You’ll Work On

  • Design website and landing pages in Figma

  • Create social media graphics and marketing creatives

  • Design creatives for organic and paid ads

  • Create visuals for web, apps, and digital campaigns

  • Edit short-form videos for social media and marketing

  • Create simple animations and motion graphics

  • Turn creative briefs and ideas into polished visual content

  • Adapt designs into different formats and platforms

  • Work closely with our team on ongoing creative requests

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in graphic design, video editing, and animation

  • Strong Figma skills

  • Experience designing landing pages / web interfaces

  • Strong portfolio showcasing social media, digital, and marketing creatives

  • Comfortable with video editing and creating simple animations

  • Strong eye for design, typography, composition, and visual storytelling

  • Able to work independently and turn around projects quickly

  • Good communication and responsiveness

Tools

Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools.

Ideal Candidate

We’re particularly interested in someone who can do both design and video. The ability to move from a landing page or social media graphic to a video or simple animation without needing to outsource another part of the work is a major plus.

This is a freelance opportunity with potential for ongoing work.

To Apply

Please send:

  1. Your portfolio

  2. Examples of your landing page/Figma work

  3. Examples of social media creatives

  4. Examples of video editing and animation

  5. Your hourly rate and availability

We’re looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

Company Overview:

Brandcoven is a leading branding and marketing agency that specializes in helping businesses and brands reach their full potential. With a team of creative and strategic experts, we work with clients to develop impactful and effective branding and marketing strategies. Our goal is to help businesses stand out in a crowded marketplace and achieve their business objectives.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Graphic Designer to join our team full-time.   • Stay up-to-date with design trends, techniques, and software to continuously improve and evolve our design capabilities
  • Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong portfolio showcasing a variety of design work
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

- Competitive salary and benefits package

- Opportunity to work with a dynamic and talented team

- A collaborative and creative work environment

- Professional development and growth opportunities

- The chance to work with a diverse range of clients and industries

- Remote and flexible work schedule

If you are a passionate and creative Graphic Designer looking to join a dynamic and growing team, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume, cover letter, and portfolio for consideration.
